name: Pyruvate
short: In a systematic review of 6 weight-loss trials, adverse events included gas, bloating, diarrhoea and a rise in LDL cholesterol; the authors said safety evidence is limited.
text: A systematic review and meta-analysis of randomised trials of pyruvate for weight loss (nine trials identified, six included, all with methodological weaknesses) reported that adverse events included gas, bloating, diarrhoea and an increase in LDL cholesterol. The abstract does not say how often these occurred or whether they were more common than with placebo, and the authors concluded that limited evidence exists about the safety of pyruvate. No interaction data were found in the cited sources.

citations.label: Onakpoya et al., 2014, Crit Rev Food Sci Nutr
citations.title: Pyruvate supplementation for weight loss: a systematic review and meta-analysis of randomized clinical trials.
